# Checklist — Ray-Ban Meta Display

**Product honesty:** On-lens SPECTOR on Ray-Ban Meta Display is **unverified**. If SPECTOR does not open or show on the lens, say so clearly. Phone rehearsal still counts as useful feedback.

Time: ~30–45 minutes. Reply by email using the feedback headings you were sent.

---

## Setup

1. Note exact model + Meta app / glasses software versions.  
2. Try phone rehearsal first: https://www.spectorlabs.io → open the player.  
3. Separately attempt whatever path you use for Web Apps / browser on Display (if any). Document exact steps.

---

## Tests

### A. Phone rehearsal (baseline)

| # | Task | Pass? | Notes |
|---|------|-------|-------|
| A1 | SPECTOR works on phone/computer | | |
| A2 | Readable at Normal speed while speaking | | |

### B. On-lens / Display path (report honestly)

| # | Task | Result | Notes |
|---|------|--------|-------|
| B1 | Can SPECTOR open or display on the lens at all? | Yes / No / Partial | |
| B2 | If yes: text readable? | | |
| B3 | Text size / spacing usable? | | |
| B4 | Comfort / motion: help or distract? | | |
| B5 | Stability (jitter, lag, dropouts) | | |
| B6 | Real-world speaking with eyes toward audience | | |

### C. Hardware controls

| # | Task | Affects SPECTOR? | Notes |
|---|------|------------------|-------|
| C1 | Temple / touch / Neural Band actions | Yes / No / Unsure | |

All Display on-lens results are **tester-reported** until SPECTOR operators promote them to **verified**.

---

## Send back

Use the feedback template headings. Include screenshots/video of the lens only if comfortable and if they do not expose private data.
